description: Java class defining an AmqpValidator for validating AMQP protocol connections, including source and target validation, URI scheme validation, and connection configuration checks.

classes.name: AmqpValidator
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractProtocolValidator, responsible for validating AMQP connection configurations, including source, target, URI schemes, and payload mappings.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AmqpValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration, including enforcement templates and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mappings and address templates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, specifically ConnectionType.AMQP_10.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the connection, including URI scheme, source, target, and payload mappings.
